feature_description: The household’s homes with their insurance and upkeep dates, the things in them with warranties, utilities and subscriptions, and papers.
cap_view: See the household’s homes, things and services
cap_edit: Add and change homes, things and services
title: Home
empty_hint: Add one to keep its insurance, upkeep dates, things with warranties and papers in one place.
not_found: This home is not here any more.
item_not_found: This thing is not here any more.
service_not_found: This service is not here any more.
error: That did not work. Please try again.
archive_home_hint: Archiving hides the home with its things and services and stops their reminders. Papers and history are kept.
archive_item_hint: Archiving hides the thing and stops its reminders, including the warranty end. Papers and history are kept.
archive_service_hint: Archiving hides the service and stops its reminders. Papers and history are kept.
home_name_hint: What the family calls it, e.g. “Our flat”.
presets_hint: These are suggestions. Tick what applies, give the next date, and set how often it comes back.
preset_heating_service_hint: Yearly maintenance of the boiler, heat pump or air conditioning. Ask your installer how often.
preset_alarm_check_hint: Test the alarms and replace the batteries.
preset_lease_review_hint: Rent, dues or a contract that renews: check it once a year.
preset_filter_change_hint: Water or air filter. Check the maker’s advice.
items_empty: No things yet. Add an appliance to keep its warranty and papers.
field_warranty_hint: Adds a “Warranty ends” reminder under What needs doing.
field_due_day_hint: Day of the month, 1 to 31. For your information only.
discard_hint: What you typed here has not been saved.
draft_title_add_item: Add a thing to a home
draft_title_update_item: Change a thing in a home
draft_title_archive_item: Archive a thing in a home
